name: Commission proposal
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing an EU talent pool
part_text:
The report sets out Parliament's position on a new EU-wide online platform, the EU Talent Pool, to match jobseekers from outside the EU with employers in Member States facing labour shortages. It wants the platform open to all skill levels, free for jobseekers, with fair recruitment rules, checks on employers, and protection against discrimination and unfair fees. It also asks for faster visa procedures and stronger links with training partnerships with non-EU countries.

- **What changes:** A shared EU job-matching platform for non-EU jobseekers, with employer checks and fair-recruitment safeguards.
- **Who it affects:** Jobseekers outside the EU, employers in participating countries, and national authorities.
- **What happens next:** Parliament adopted its first-reading position; talks with EU governments follow before the law can be finalised.
